title_html: What Is GMV Max on TikTok Shop? (And How Two Brands Turned It Into Real Revenue)
description: GMV is the sales your TikTok Shop moves; GMV Max is the paid lever that scales it. Here's what both mean, and how two brands turned GMV Max into real revenue.
dek: GMV is the scoreboard on TikTok Shop — GMV Max is the paid lever that moves it. Here's what both actually mean, and how two food and beverage brands turned GMV Max into real revenue: one by fixing it, one by stacking it.
author: Jackie He
cta_pre: Put GMV Max to work on your shop.
llms_summary: A plain-language explainer of GMV (gross merchandise value) and GMV Max, TikTok Shop's automated ad product that amplifies content already converting - anchored to two food and beverage brands: one that recovered a broken GMV Max lever (+112% GMV week over week), one that stacked concentrated ad spend with promo and affiliates into a first six-figure month ($100K in 26 days).
